items.title: Bobby Hutcherson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He did so many important things for Monk.

ctx.x: with Orrin Keepnews and Landmark Records, and secondly your association most recently with the S.F. Jazz Collective.

Orrin – he’s a landmark himself. He’s done so much. An unbelievable book of knowledge. He did so many important things for Monk. He could write a story on how the development of Monk’s music within that time that he was working with him, how it all got stronger and stronger, and how he became this statesman for jazz throughout the world. Orrin is known for his gift of gab. It’s hard to get him to stop talking, once he’s – just like me.
